from_speaker: will not give China, the US, or anyone else interstellar starships
will not give anyone an insuperable military advantage
our_interpretation: No deadline is stated. The nearby 2024 reference is not automatically imported into this separate prediction.
Give means materially enable the capability, with documented causation attributable to GPT-5.
Interstellar starships means operational craft designed for travel between stars.
Insuperable military advantage means decisive superiority that opponents cannot overcome, rather than better performance on selected military tasks.
The statement about magic is rhetorical; the two concrete capability predictions are assessed.
criteria.support_condition: Conclusive evidence establishes that GPT-5 cannot enable either specified capability. Continued absence over a finite observation period is insufficient for these undated negatives.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A verified operational interstellar starship or demonstrably insuperable military advantage is materially enabled by GPT-5.
